'''2020 TMW Round of 16 Jacy Smith LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jacy Smith]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Round of 16).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jacy Smith]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Round of 16
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open TIGIH Smith LS 2020 Texas 2.txt |Download]]
